@graph.headline: SEO, Local Search, and AI Visibility for Home Builders
@graph.description: Learn how technical SEO, local search, useful answers, structured data, and source clarity can support home builder visibility across search and AI systems.

mainEntity.name: What is SEO for home builders?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is the work of making a builder's useful pages technically accessible, clearly organized, relevant to buyer questions, supported by real proof, and measurable in search and lead systems.

mainEntity.name: How is local SEO different from general SEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: Local SEO adds real-world business identity, service geography, local proof, reviews, profiles, and citations to the broader technical and content foundation.

mainEntity.name: What do AEO and GEO mean?

acceptedAnswer.text: AEO focuses on direct, accurate answers to specific questions. GEO focuses on clear entities, evidence, and source relationships that generative systems can interpret. Neither guarantees selection in an answer.

mainEntity.name: Does FAQ schema guarantee a rich result?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Structured data can help systems understand page content, but Google does not guarantee a rich result and has limited FAQ rich-result visibility for most sites.

mainEntity.name: Can an agency guarantee search rankings or AI visibility?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. An agency can improve crawlability, content quality, local consistency, evidence, and measurement, but ranking and generated-answer selection remain controlled by external systems.
